facts.fact: Eran 上门传达王命：要带亚当去宫廷，国王要求他到场。
facts.anchor: “I am to bring you to court. The king requires your presence.”

facts.fact: Silver 当庭宣读亚当的全名与头衔：Adam Lee Binder, first of his name, Page of Swords，Robert Jack Binder the first 与 Tilla Mae Binder the first 之子。
facts.anchor: “Adam Lee Binder, first of his name, Page of Swords, son of Robert Jack Binder the first and Tilla Mae Binder the first.”

facts.fact: Silver 宣布即将就『亚当以职务武器杀死一名凡人』一事作出判决。
facts.anchor: “So I am ready to pass judgment on the matter of the mortal you killed with your weapon of office.”

facts.fact: Silver 宣判 Dautre 的战场抗命：那个决定害死许多 Lost Ones，却也救下许多己方。
facts.anchor: You made a battlefield decision to disobey us, a decision that cost many Lost Ones their lives, though it saved many of our own.

facts.fact: Silver 判 Dautre 因未能理解凡人生命的价值，被逐出此宫廷与精灵同伴之列一个世纪（one century）。
facts.anchor: As you failed to understand the value of mortal life, we ostracize you from this court and elven company for one century.

facts.fact: Dautre 被改派往西部瞭望塔（western watchtower），听凭 King of Coins 分派的职务。
facts.anchor: You will instead be sent to the western watchtower, to assume whatever duties the King of Coins asks you to perform.

facts.fact: Eran 解释树上挂满各色丝带是悼念：当天死去的每一个人一条，不分种族、无论是否 Lost。
facts.anchor: “We do this in mourning,” Eran explained. “There is one for each person who died that day, regardless of their race, Lost or not.”

facts.fact: 结尾点题：亚当要想玩长线游戏救 Ian，就必须先拯救世界。
facts.anchor: If he wanted to play the long game and save Ian, he first had to save the world.
